channel.title: Alper Refrigerants
channel.description: Wholesale refrigerants and HVAC equipment for licensed professionals. EPA 608 certification required for refrigerant purchases.

item.g:title: AccuTools eL-720 Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Gas Leak Detector | HVAC and Refrigeration Tool
item.g:description: The AccuTools eL-720 Carbon Dioxide Gas Leak Detector is a professional-grade instrument designed to quickly and accurately locate CO2 leaks in HVAC and refrigeration systems. Featuring advanced infrared sensor technology, it provides pinpoint accuracy and fast response times, making it an essential tool for technicians and wholesalers. Detects trace levels of CO2 (R744) with high sensitivity, using LED and audible leak indicators with variable intensity levels.

item.g:title: AlperPro 1 HP Refrigerant Recovery Machine 115V
item.g:description: A 1 HP oil-less recovery machine for pulling refrigerant out of a system into a DOT recovery cylinder, which federal rules require before opening any circuit for service or disposal. The oil-less twin-cylinder compressor means no crankcase oil to contaminate recovered refrigerant, and it handles vapour, liquid and push-pull recovery with a high-pressure cut-out at 550 psi. Rated for R-22, R-410A, R-134a, R-404A, R-407C and other common HFC and HCFC refrigerants; it is not rated for A2L flammable refrigerants such as R-32 or R-454B, which require a listed A2L machine. Recovery rate is roughly 0.5 lb per minute of vapour and up to 7 lb per minute in liquid push-pull. Includes a carry frame, dual gauges and a 1/4 in SAE inlet and outlet. Use only with a certified recovery cylinder and never fill past 80 percent.

item.g:title: AlperPro 1/2 in Large Bore High Vacuum Evacuation Hose, 6 ft
item.g:description: Large bore evacuation hose for pulling deep vacuums quickly. A 1/2 in internal bore moves far more air per minute than a standard 1/4 in charging hose, so systems reach a low micron reading in a fraction of the time. Internal bore: 1/2 in. Length: 6 ft. Fittings: brass swivel connections at both ends. Intended for evacuation service, not for refrigerant charging through a manifold.

item.g:title: AlperPro 1/4 in Valve Core Removal Tool with Ball Valve
item.g:description: Brass inline core removal tool that lets a technician pull the Schrader core from a 1/4 in service port, so evacuation and charging happen through the full port instead of past a restrictive valve core. The integral ball valve holds the system while the core is replaced, without breaking vacuum. Port size: 1/4 in flare. Body: brass with a ball valve lever and knurled removal knob. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B, R-32 and HFC service pressures.

item.g:title: AlperPro 16 ft Pre-Flared Insulated Copper Line Set 1/4 in x 3/8 in for Mini-Split Systems
item.g:description: Pre-flared insulated copper line set for ductless mini-split and heat pump installations. Includes a 1/4 in liquid line and a 3/8 in suction line, each individually insulated and fitted with brass flare nuts so the set connects straight to the indoor and outdoor units. Length: 16 ft. Line sizes: 1/4 in and 3/8 in. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B and R-32 systems rated for flare connections. Sold as one complete line set.

item.g:title: AlperPro 2-Valve Manifold Gauge Set R134a Automotive
item.g:description: A two-valve manifold set scaled for R-134a automotive air conditioning work, with quick-couplers that snap onto the low and high side service ports used on passenger vehicles and light trucks. The high-side gauge reads to 500 psi and the low-side compound gauge reads vacuum to 250 psi, both with colour-coded dials and shock-resistant lenses. Hoses are 72 in, long enough to reach across an engine bay while the manifold hangs from the hood. The aluminium body keeps the assembly light for mobile technicians who carry it all day. This set is intended for R-134a service only; R-1234yf systems require dedicated equipment and couplers, and mixing service equipment between the two refrigerants is prohibited. Sold to repair shops, fleet workshops and mobile technicians, with case pricing for multi-bay operations.

item.g:title: AlperPro 25 ft Pre-Flared Insulated Copper Line Set 1/4 in x 1/2 in for Mini-Split Systems
item.g:description: Pre-flared insulated copper line set sized for larger capacity mini-split and multi-zone heat pump installations. Includes a 1/4 in liquid line and a 1/2 in suction line, each individually insulated and fitted with brass flare nuts. Length: 25 ft. Line sizes: 1/4 in and 1/2 in. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B and R-32 systems rated for flare connections. Sold as one complete line set.

item.g:title: AlperPro 25 ft Pre-Flared Insulated Copper Line Set 1/4 in x 3/8 in for Mini-Split Systems
item.g:description: Pre-flared insulated copper line set for ductless mini-split and heat pump installations. Includes a 1/4 in liquid line and a 3/8 in suction line, each individually insulated and fitted with brass flare nuts. Length: 25 ft. Line sizes: 1/4 in and 3/8 in. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B and R-32 systems rated for flare connections. Sold as one complete line set.

item.g:title: AlperPro 3/8 in Large Bore High Vacuum Evacuation Hose, 6 ft
item.g:description: Large bore evacuation hose with a 3/8 in internal bore, a practical middle size for residential and light commercial evacuation where a 1/2 in hose is more than the equipment ports need. Internal bore: 3/8 in. Length: 6 ft. Fittings: brass swivel connections at both ends. Intended for evacuation service rather than charging.

item.g:title: AlperPro 30 lb DOT-4BA400 Refrigerant Recovery Cylinder with Dual Y-Valve and Float Switch
item.g:description: Empty 30 lb refrigerant recovery cylinder built to DOT-4BA400 specification, with a dual Y-valve giving separate liquid and vapour service ports and an 80 percent float switch that signals a recovery machine to shut down before the tank is overfilled. Capacity: 30 lb. Service pressure: 400 psig. Valve: dual port liquid and vapour with protective collar. Supplied empty, with no refrigerant charge. Recovered refrigerant must be handled by an EPA Section 608 certified technician.

item.g:title: AlperPro 4-Valve Brass Manifold Gauge Set R410A R22 R404A
item.g:description: A four-valve brass manifold designed for R-410A pressures, with dual low-side and high-side ports so a technician can pull vacuum and charge without breaking connections. The forged brass body carries a 800 psi high-side and 250 psi low-side working range with a 4,000 psi burst rating, and the 2.5 in class 1.0 gauges are dampened for readable needles on a running system. Sight glass in the manifold body shows liquid flow during charging. Supplied with three 60 in 1/4 in SAE charging hoses rated 800 psi working pressure and fitted with ball-valve depressors, plus a hanging hook and moulded case. Scales are printed for R-410A, R-22 and R-404A so it covers the great majority of residential and light commercial service calls. Sold to HVAC contractors, service fleets and training programs; case and pallet pricing available.

item.g:title: AlperPro 5 CFM Two-Stage Refrigerant Vacuum Pump
item.g:description: A two-stage rotary-vane vacuum pump rated 5 CFM with an ultimate vacuum of 15 microns, sized for residential split systems, mini-splits and light commercial work up to roughly five tons. Two stages matter: a single-stage pump stalls in the range where water actually boils out of a system, while a two-stage pump keeps pulling to a deep vacuum so moisture leaves instead of staying behind to form acid. The 1/2 HP motor starts under load at low ambient temperature, and the isolation valve at the inlet lets the pump be shut off for a decay test without losing vacuum. An oil sight glass and bottom drain make oil changes quick, which is the single biggest factor in pump life. Supplied with 1/4 in and 3/8 in SAE inlet fittings, one bottle of vacuum pump oil and a carry handle.

item.g:title: AlperPro 5/16 in Valve Core Removal Tool with Ball Valve for R-410A Systems
item.g:description: Brass inline core removal tool sized for the 5/16 in service ports fitted to R-410A and other high pressure systems. Removing the Schrader core opens the full port for fast evacuation, and the integral ball valve holds the system while the core is refitted so the vacuum is not lost. Port size: 5/16 in flare. Body: brass with a ball valve lever and knurled removal knob. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B and R-32 service pressures.

item.g:title: AlperPro 50 ft Pre-Flared Insulated Copper Line Set 1/4 in x 3/8 in for Mini-Split Systems
item.g:description: Long-run pre-flared insulated copper line set for installations where the outdoor unit sits well away from the indoor head. Includes a 1/4 in liquid line and a 3/8 in suction line, each individually insulated and fitted with brass flare nuts. Length: 50 ft. Line sizes: 1/4 in and 3/8 in. Suitable for R-410A, R-454B and R-32 systems rated for flare connections. Sold as one complete line set.

item.g:title: AlperPro 50 lb DOT Refrigerant Recovery Cylinder
item.g:description: A 50 lb DOT-4BA400 recovery cylinder with a Y-valve giving separate liquid and vapour ports, which is what makes push-pull recovery and clean cylinder transfer possible. The tare weight is stamped on the collar so a technician can calculate the 80 percent fill limit precisely rather than guessing, and the grey body with yellow shoulder follows the industry convention for recovered refrigerant. Interior is treated to resist moisture and the float switch port accepts an 80 percent shut-off sensor. Cylinders are hydrostatically tested and date-stamped at manufacture; requalification is required every five years under DOT rules. Shipped empty. This is regulated hazardous-materials hardware sold to certified technicians and licensed shops only; recovered refrigerant must never be vented and cylinders must not be overfilled or exposed above 125 F.

item.g:title: AlperPro 50 lb DOT-4BA400 Refrigerant Recovery Cylinder with Dual Y-Valve and Float Switch
item.g:description: Empty 50 lb refrigerant recovery cylinder built to DOT-4BA400 specification for larger commercial recovery jobs. The dual Y-valve provides separate liquid and vapour ports, and the 80 percent float switch signals the recovery machine to stop before overfill. Capacity: 50 lb. Service pressure: 400 psig. Valve: dual port liquid and vapour with protective collar. Supplied empty, with no refrigerant charge. Recovered refrigerant must be handled by an EPA Section 608 certified technician.

item.g:title: AlperPro 8 CFM Two-Stage Refrigerant Vacuum Pump
item.g:description: An 8 CFM two-stage vacuum pump for larger jobs: multi-zone systems, rooftop units, long line-set runs and commercial refrigeration racks where a 5 CFM pump would take hours to reach target. Ultimate vacuum is 15 microns, the motor is 1 HP and the large-bore 3/8 in inlet reduces the restriction that usually limits real-world pumping speed more than the pump itself. Included are 1/4 in and 3/8 in SAE fittings and an inlet isolation valve for decay testing. The cast aluminium housing and thermally protected motor tolerate long continuous runs on hot roofs, and the oil sight glass plus bottom drain keep servicing simple between calls. Recommended pairing is a micron gauge on the system rather than at the pump, and 3/8 in evacuation hoses instead of standard charging hoses.

item.g:title: AlperPro Alkylbenzene ISO 150 Refrigeration Compressor Oil, 1 Gallon
item.g:description: Synthetic alkylbenzene (AB) refrigeration lubricant, ISO viscosity grade 150. Alkylbenzene oil is used on R-22 systems and on R-22 retrofit blends such as R-422D and R-438A, where it carries better with the blend than straight mineral oil. ISO viscosity grade: 150. Container: 1 US gallon. Confirm the compressor nameplate oil requirement before adding, and never mix oil types without the manufacturer approval.

item.g:title: AlperPro Anti-Vibration Rubber Pad and Riser Set for HVAC Condenser Units, Set of 4
item.g:description: Moulded rubber anti-vibration pads that isolate an outdoor condenser or heat pump from its pad or mounting frame, cutting transmitted noise and protecting fasteners from vibration fatigue. Set of four ribbed rubber blocks with a recessed channel that seats the unit foot or rail. Suitable for mini-split condensers, heat pumps and small commercial condensing units.

item.g:title: AlperPro Brass Quick-Coupler and Adapter Kit 14 Piece
item.g:description: A fourteen-piece brass fitting kit that solves the connection problems that stop a service call: 1/4 in SAE to 5/16 in R-410A adapters, straight and 45 and 90 degree ball-valve couplers, tank adapters for both left-hand and right-hand thread cylinders, and blanking caps with captive gaskets. Every body is machined brass with a Teflon-sealed core depressor rather than a rubber washer, so the fittings hold on 800 psi high-side pressure and do not blow out when a hose is charged. The ball-valve couplers let hoses be isolated and removed without dumping the hose charge to atmosphere, which is both a compliance point and a cost saving on expensive refrigerant. Packed in a labelled tin so the sizes stay identifiable. A standard restock item for service vans.

item.g:title: AlperPro Copper Tubing Tool Kit Flaring Swaging and Cutter
item.g:description: The hand-tool set that decides whether a mini-split installation holds vacuum. It contains an eccentric-cone 45 degree flaring tool sized for 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, 1/2, 5/8 and 3/4 in soft copper, a ratcheting tube cutter with a spare wheel, a deburring reamer, five swaging adapters and a spring bender set. The eccentric cone is the important part: it forms a smooth, work-hardened flare face that seals against a torqued flare nut, where a straight-yoke tool leaves ridges that weep refrigerant months later. Cutting square and reaming the burr before flaring prevents chips entering the circuit. All tools are hardened steel with a blow-moulded case that keeps the sizes in order on a truck. Sold in single kits and in case quantities for training programs and install crews.

item.g:title: AlperPro Digital Manifold Gauge Set with Bluetooth and Probes
item.g:description: A digital manifold that replaces analogue gauges with two 0 to 800 psi pressure transducers, two clamp-on temperature probes and a live superheat and subcooling readout, so charging decisions are made from calculated values rather than a pressure chart. More than eighty refrigerant profiles are stored on board, including R-410A, R-32, R-454B, R-134a, R-404A and R-407C, and the unit reports target subcooling against the manufacturer table. Bluetooth pairing streams a session log to a phone so readings can be attached to a service ticket or commissioning report. The housing is rubber-armoured with IP54 sealing, magnetic hook and rechargeable battery rated about 25 hours per charge. Included are two 60 in hoses, two pipe clamp thermocouples, USB-C charging cable and a hard case. Volume pricing for service fleets and distributors.

item.g:title: AlperPro Digital Refrigerant Charging Scale 220 lb
item.g:description: A 220 lb capacity refrigerant scale with 0.5 oz resolution, the tool that turns charging from guesswork into a weighed procedure. Mini-splits in particular must be charged by weight against the nameplate figure plus a line-length allowance, and this scale resolves finely enough to hit that number on a small system. The platform is cast aluminium with a rubberised cylinder rest, and the detachable display sits on a magnetic bracket so it can be read at eye level while the cylinder stays on the floor. Functions include tare, unit switching between pounds, ounces and kilograms, hold and low-battery indication. The hinged case protects the load cell in a truck bed, which is where most scales are damaged. Powered by a 9V battery. Case and pallet pricing available to distributors.

item.g:title: AlperPro Heated Diaphragm Electronic Refrigerant Leak Detector
item.g:description: A heated-diaphragm leak detector that responds to halogenated refrigerants at a sensitivity of about 0.14 oz per year, sensitive enough to find the slow seepage that shows up as a system losing charge over a season. Heated-diaphragm sensing is the preferred technology for service work because it ignores most shop contaminants such as oil mist and solvent vapour that trigger false alarms on cheaper corona-discharge detectors. Three sensitivity levels and both audible and visual indication let a technician zero out background concentration and then close in on the actual point of loss. The 15 in flexible stainless probe reaches behind coils and into evaporator cabinets. Detects R-410A, R-32, R-454B, R-134a, R-22, R-404A and other halogenated refrigerants. Ships with a spare sensor, batteries and a moulded case.

item.g:title: AlperPro Heavy-Duty Wall Mounting Bracket Pair for Mini-Split and Heat Pump Condensers
item.g:description: Powder-coated galvanized steel wall mounting bracket pair for outdoor mini-split condensers and heat pump units. Raising the unit off the ground keeps the base clear of snow, standing water and debris, which protects the coil and drain pan. Supplied as a pair with mounting bolts and adjustable slotted arms. Rated to support up to 300 lb combined when installed into solid masonry or framing per the included instructions.

item.g:title: AlperPro HVAC Digital Clamp Meter with Temperature Probes
item.g:description: A true-RMS clamp meter specified for HVAC work rather than general electrical: 600 A AC current, 600 V AC and DC, capacitance to 4000 microfarads for testing run and start capacitors, microamps for flame-rectification checks on gas equipment, and two type-K temperature inputs for measuring air or line temperature split. True-RMS matters on inverter-driven equipment where a mean-averaging meter misreads the distorted waveform. The 30 mm jaw closes around typical compressor and contactor conductors, and non-contact voltage detection gives a quick live-circuit check before the leads come out. The backlit display with hold and min/max makes readings possible inside a dark air handler. Includes silicone test leads, two bead thermocouples, batteries and a soft case. CAT III 600 V rated.

item.g:title: AlperPro Nitrogen Flow Indicator 0-50 SCFH for Brazing Purge
item.g:description: Inline flow indicator that shows the low nitrogen flow used when brazing. A floating ball in a clear tube lets the technician confirm a steady trickle of gas through the line set instead of guessing at the regulator. Range: 0 to 50 SCFH. Connections: brass threaded inlet and outlet. Fits between the nitrogen regulator and the purge hose.

item.g:title: AlperPro Nitrogen Purge Regulator 0-800 PSI with CGA-580 Cylinder Connection
item.g:description: Two stage nitrogen regulator for purging and pressure testing HVAC line sets. Flowing dry nitrogen while brazing prevents the copper oxide scale that otherwise forms inside the tubing and later blocks metering devices, and the same regulator is used for standing pressure leak tests. Outlet range: 0 to 800 psi. Inlet connection: CGA-580 for inert gas cylinders. Two pressure gauges show cylinder and delivery pressure. Nitrogen cylinder is not included.

item.g:title: AlperPro PAG 100 Refrigerant Compressor Oil for R-134a Mobile Air Conditioning, 1 Quart
item.g:description: Polyalkylene glycol (PAG) compressor lubricant, viscosity grade 100, for mobile and transport air conditioning compressors that specify the heavier PAG grade. Viscosity grade: PAG 100. Container: 1 US quart. PAG and POE oils are not interchangeable; follow the vehicle or compressor manufacturer specification and reseal the bottle after use.

item.g:title: AlperPro PAG 46 Refrigerant Compressor Oil for R-134a Mobile Air Conditioning, 1 Quart
item.g:description: Polyalkylene glycol (PAG) compressor lubricant, viscosity grade 46, for mobile and transport air conditioning systems running R-134a and R-1234yf where the manufacturer specifies PAG 46. Viscosity grade: PAG 46. Container: 1 US quart. PAG and POE oils are not interchangeable; use the grade listed by the vehicle or compressor manufacturer and reseal the bottle after use.

item.g:title: AlperPro POE ISO 32 Synthetic Polyolester Refrigeration Compressor Oil, 1 Gallon
item.g:description: Synthetic polyolester (POE) refrigeration compressor lubricant, ISO viscosity grade 32. POE is the lubricant specified for HFC and HFO systems including R-410A, R-404A, R-407C, R-454B and R-32, where mineral oil will not return to the compressor. ISO viscosity grade: 32. Container: 1 US gallon. Always confirm the oil type and viscosity called for on the compressor nameplate before charging, and keep the container sealed because POE absorbs moisture rapidly from the air.

item.g:title: AlperPro POE ISO 32 Synthetic Polyolester Refrigeration Compressor Oil, 1 Quart
item.g:description: Synthetic polyolester (POE) refrigeration compressor lubricant, ISO viscosity grade 32, in a service-size quart can for top-ups and small charges. Specified for HFC and HFO systems such as R-410A, R-404A, R-407C, R-454B and R-32. ISO viscosity grade: 32. Container: 1 US quart. Confirm the oil type and viscosity on the compressor nameplate before charging and reseal the can immediately, as POE is strongly hygroscopic.

item.g:title: AlperPro POE ISO 68 Synthetic Polyolester Refrigeration Compressor Oil, 1 Gallon
item.g:description: Higher viscosity synthetic polyolester (POE) refrigeration lubricant, ISO viscosity grade 68, for commercial refrigeration compressors and chillers that specify a heavier oil than ISO 32. ISO viscosity grade: 68. Container: 1 US gallon. Match the viscosity grade to the compressor nameplate requirement, and keep sealed until use because POE absorbs atmospheric moisture quickly.

item.g:title: AlperPro PVC Line Set Cover Kit for Mini-Split Installations, White
item.g:description: Decorative PVC line set cover kit that conceals and protects the refrigerant lines, drain hose and control wiring running down an exterior wall, giving a finished commercial-grade installation. Kit includes straight duct channel sections, elbow joints, a wall inlet cover and end caps. UV-stable white finish that can be painted to match the wall.

item.g:title: AlperPro Refrigerant Handling Safety Kit Gloves and Face Shield
item.g:description: Personal protective equipment matched to refrigerant handling, where the hazard is not heat but rapid freezing: liquid refrigerant released to atmosphere flashes at well below freezing and causes cold burns on contact. The kit contains cryogenic-rated gauntlet gloves with a leather palm and insulated cuff that covers the forearm, an anti-fog polycarbonate face shield with adjustable ratchet headgear meeting ANSI Z87.1 impact requirements, splash-resistant safety goggles for tighter spaces, and hearing protection for recovery-machine and vacuum-pump work. All items pack into a labelled pouch that can live in the van rather than being scattered. Required on site under most employer safety programs when breaking into a pressurised circuit or filling a recovery cylinder. Sold to contractors, facilities teams and training providers in single and case quantities.

item.g:title: AlperPro Valve Core Removal Tool Set with Ball Valve
item.g:description: A valve core removal tool lets a technician change a leaking Schrader core, or remove cores entirely for a faster evacuation, without recovering the whole system charge. The tool threads onto the service port, isolates with an integral ball valve, and a sealed hex shaft engages the core so it can be backed out under pressure and captured. Removing cores during evacuation is standard practice on long line sets because the core restricts flow enough to add an hour or more to reaching a deep vacuum. The set covers 1/4 in and 5/16 in ports, includes a side 1/4 in SAE access port for connecting a hose while the tool is fitted, and comes with a pack of replacement cores in both standard and R-410A high-pressure specification, plus spare O-rings. Machined brass body rated to 800 psi.

item.g:title: AlperPro Wireless Digital Vacuum Micron Gauge
item.g:description: A vacuum gauge that reads from atmospheric pressure down to 10 microns, which is the only reliable way to confirm a system has been evacuated properly before charging. The thermistor sensor is field-cleanable, an important detail because oil contamination is the usual reason cheap micron gauges start reading falsely low. A programmable target alarm sounds when the system reaches setpoint, and the decay-test mode holds and graphs pressure rise after the pump is isolated so a technician can distinguish trapped moisture from a genuine leak. Bluetooth pairing lets the reading be watched from the truck while the pump runs. Housing is impact-resistant with a magnetic base and 1/4 in SAE swivel connection. Ships with a 1/4 in tee adapter and batteries. Trade pricing by case and pallet.

item.g:title: Amana 12000 BTU PTAC Heat Pump 230V with Electric Backup
item.g:description: The 12,000 BTU packaged terminal heat pump is the standard specification for larger hotel rooms, suites and one-bedroom apartments that exceed the capacity of a 9,000 BTU chassis. It fits the same 42 x 16 inch wall sleeve, so a property can mix capacities across a floor without changing openings. Reversing-valve heating is supplemented by 5 kW electric resistance backup for design-day conditions and defrost cycles. Cooling rates at 10.7 EER, and the chassis includes a washable filter, corrosion-treated coils suited to coastal properties and front-panel or remote wall thermostat control. Buyers usually order by pallet for renovation projects; unit pricing improves at five, twenty and full-container quantities. Delivery is by freight to a dock or lift-gate address, and we can stage shipments floor by floor on request.

item.g:title: Amana 15000 BTU PTAC Heat Pump
item.g:description: Wholesale 15,000 BTU PTAC heat pump with electric backup heat and corrosion-resistant coils. Hospitality-grade through-wall unit with exterior grille and wall sleeve available. The Amana 15000 BTU PTAC Heat Pump delivers 15,000 BTU/h of cooling and is sized for up to 700 sq ft. It carries a 11.2 EER efficiency rating, which is what determines running cost once the unit is in service — the higher the rating, the less the same amount of cooling costs your customer or tenant each season. The unit slides into a standard through-wall sleeve with an exterior grille, so replacing a unit in an existing opening is a swap rather than a renovation. As a heat pump it also heats, moving heat indoors down to moderate outdoor temperatures and falling back to electric resistance heat below that, which lets one piece of equipment carry a guest room year round. Units are hardwired. Electrically it runs on 230V, 1-Phase, 60Hz, and connects via Hardwired. Confirm the circuit before delivery: a 230V unit needs a dedicated 230V circuit, and hardwired models need a licensed electrician to terminate the connection. It is charged with R-410A, still the most widely stocked service refrigerant in North America, which keeps future maintenance simple and parts and gas easy to source. We stock R-410A in bulk, so service gas can ship alongside the units. Typical buyers are hotel and motel groups, apartment and assisted-living operators, and commercial contractors running refurbishment programs. Order a single unit or a full load. Pricing is tiered: single and small orders of one to four units carry a handling rate, unit rates improve from five units, and the lowest per-unit price applies from 12 units. Units ship from US warehouses with freight quoted at cost, and orders can be invoiced by bank wire at a discount.

item.g:title: Amana 9000 BTU PTAC Heat Pump 230V with Electric Backup
item.g:description: A packaged terminal heat pump that slides into the industry-standard 42 x 16 inch wall sleeve used across hotels, motels, assisted-living rooms and student housing. Everything is in one chassis, so replacement is a swap rather than a refrigeration job: pull the old unit, slide the new one into the existing sleeve, connect the cord and set the front controls. The heat pump reverses for heating and hands off to 3.5 kW electric resistance backup when outdoor temperature drops below the balance point, so the room stays warm in any climate. Cooling rates at 11.0 EER with a washable filter and front-panel or wired-thermostat control. Sold in case and pallet quantities to hospitality buyers, property managers and contractors; a new sleeve and exterior grille can be quoted with the order if the existing opening is being rebuilt.

item.g:title: Amana 9000 BTU PTAC with Electric Heat
item.g:description: Wholesale 9,000 BTU packaged terminal air conditioner with 3.5 kW electric heat strip. Standard 42 inch chassis for hotels, apartments and assisted-living facilities. The Amana 9000 BTU PTAC with Electric Heat delivers 9,000 BTU/h of cooling and is sized for up to 400 sq ft. It carries a 11.7 EER efficiency rating, which is what determines running cost once the unit is in service — the higher the rating, the less the same amount of cooling costs your customer or tenant each season. The unit slides into a standard through-wall sleeve with an exterior grille, so replacing a unit in an existing hotel or apartment opening is a swap rather than a renovation — the room is back in service the same day. item.g:title: Appion G5Twin Refrigerant Recovery Machine | High-Speed EPA-Compliant Recovery
item.g:description: The Appion G5Twin Refrigerant Recovery Machine is a high-performance recovery unit designed for HVAC technicians, contractors, and industrial users who need speed, durability, and EPA compliance. Built with a twin-cylinder, twin-condenser design, the G5Twin delivers fast recovery rates for R410A, R134a, R22, R32 and other common refrigerants, making it a professional-grade choice for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Oil-less 1/2 HP compressor, 115V/60Hz, recovery rate up to 2.5 lbs/min.

item.g:title: Black+Decker 14000 BTU Portable AC
item.g:description: Powerful portable air conditioner with dehumidifier function. 14000 BTU, easy-roll casters, programmable timer. The Black+Decker 14000 BTU Portable AC delivers 14,000 BTU/h of cooling and is sized for up to 500 sq ft. It carries a SACC 14,000 BTU efficiency rating, which is what determines running cost once the unit is in service — the higher the rating, the less the same amount of cooling costs your customer or tenant each season. No permanent installation is required. The unit rolls on casters, the exhaust hose vents through the supplied window bracket, and it plugs into a standard outlet. That makes it the usual answer for leased spaces where the landlord permits no modifications, for server and telecom closets that overheat, for event and tent cooling, and for keeping a space usable while a fixed system is being repaired or replaced. Electrically it runs on 115V, 1-Phase, 60Hz, and connects via NEMA 5-15P. Confirm the circuit before delivery: a 115V unit works from common building circuits, but it should be on its own breaker rather than shared with lighting or appliances. It is charged with R-32, a lower-GWP refrigerant now standard on new US equipment. Servicing requires R-32-rated gauges and recovery equipment, and we stock R-32 in bulk so service gas can ship alongside the units.
